data.title: Long document *first*, question last
data.subtitle: Habit 8. The order Anthropic recommends for long inputs.

items: Ask for the word-for-word **quotes** that matter
Put your **question** at the very end

blocks.text: In Anthropic's tests, questions at the end **can improve response quality by up to 30%**, most with long, complex inputs.
Quotes first keeps the answer tied to the text.

<document>
[paste the document]
</document>
First pull out the word-for-word quotes that matter, in <quotes> tags. Answer only from them.
My question: [your question]

items: It **reduces** mistakes, it doesn't remove them
Check key quotes against the source
Long messages use more of your limit
